name: solve-plugin
description: Run your customer and sales work in Solve CRM from Codex: find, read, create and update contacts, companies, projects and support tickets, manage tasks, notes, follow-ups and deals, and report on your calendar, open deals and tracked time. Includes a skill with Solve CRM's query rules and record-handling conventions.

interface.longDescription: Work with your Solve CRM from Codex using plain language. Find and read contacts, companies, projects and support tickets, create and update them, and manage the activities attached to them - tasks, notes, follow-ups, calls and deals. Ask across your data too: this week's calendar, open deals, overdue follow-ups, billable time. A bundled skill supplies Solve CRM's query rules and its conventions for changing records.
defaultPrompt: Find contacts from Seattle with first name Aaron
What's on my Solve calendar this week?

positive.description: Multi-criteria contact search combined into a single query
positive.prompt: Find contacts from Seattle with first name Aaron
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the search and query-format documentation, then issues ONE solve360_search call combining both criteria. Returns the matching contacts by name, with no internal record IDs shown.

positive.description: Weekly calendar rendered as a grid
positive.prompt: What's on my Solve calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the user's timezone from solve360_account, then renders a calendar grid (rows = weeks, columns = Sun-Sat) with event titles placed in their date cells, not a flat list.

positive.description: Load full record detail in one batched call
positive.prompt: Show full details for the company England Landscaping
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the company, then loads the record and its categories in a single solve360_batch call. Displays field values and tag labels, never raw IDs.

positive.description: Create a dated follow-up activity on an existing record
positive.prompt: Add a follow-up on the England Landscaping company for next Tuesday
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the activity documentation and confirms that Record > Follow-up is a supported hierarchy, resolves "next Tuesday" to a concrete date using the account timezone, and creates the follow-up on the company record with the due date set. Confirms success in plain language.

positive.description: Time tracking report with billable split
positive.prompt: Show my time tracking for this month
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the period's time records with the total time recorded and a breakdown of billable versus non-billable hours.

negative.description: Deletion is never executed in the same turn as the request
negative.prompt: Delete the Solve contact John Smith
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call solve360_delete_record. Identifies the record and asks the user to confirm the deletion explicitly, deleting only after a separate confirmation.

negative.description: Record creation without ownership is not silently made private
negative.prompt: Create a contact for Jane Doe at England Landscaping
negative.expected_behavior: Does not create the record immediately. Asks the user to confirm they want the record private or shared with a group, and aborts if the user declines.

negative.description: A record that does not exist is reported as not found, never fabricated
negative.prompt: Show me full details for the company Acme Corporation
negative.expected_behavior: Searches for the company, finds no match, and states plainly that no such company exists in Solve CRM. Does not invent a record, its fields or its activities, and does not silently substitute a similarly named company.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It reads and writes the user's own Solve CRM data.

publication.release_notes: Updated the plugin icon so the Solve mark stays legible on light backgrounds as well as dark. Appearance only - the MCP server, tools, bundled skill and permissions are unchanged from version 1.0.12.
